title: Board View — Render Columns and Cards in Order
description: Render the active board as ordered column lanes, each showing its cards in cardOrder, driven entirely by the store ordering arrays.
spec:
1. Render one lane per column id in board.columnOrder
2. Within each lane render cards in the column cardOrder
3. Verify reordering the underlying arrays re-renders the UI in the new order
4. Verify a column with zero cards renders an empty drop area
5. Verify a board with zero columns renders a clear call to add a column
